scientific_integrity: All stated unrestricted results follow from a complete analytic proof; the standalone finite checks are supplemental and do not constitute an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Sharp independent coefficient box requires mutually orthogonal coordinate triples; no classification for overlapping or nonorthogonal cubic modes.
Only two-dimensional orthogonal projections and spherical support-curvature operator are classified.
No claim of absolute historical priority; unindexed tensor norm identities may imply portions of the energy-allocation lemma.
title: Sharp independent-block convexity and planar-shadow extremizers for cubic constant-width bodies
